Experiment ID: #203389

### Save the Children

#### Experiment Summary

Ended On:

This test aimed to assess the impact of adding a visual monthly callout on the donation form. We hypothesized that this would create a stronger proposition for monthly giving.

#### Research Question

Adding a heart icon to the monthly option that fills when selected will encourage users to complete a recurring gift.

| T1: | [Treatment 1](https://www.nextafter.com/wp-content/uploads/837d0c74_1776638122694_Screenshot2026-04-19at5.33.49-PM.png) | 11.5% | 23.1% | 99.3% |

This experiment has a required sample size of 1,530 in order to be valid. Since the experiment had a total sample size of 5,762, and the level of confidence is above 95% the **experiment results are valid.**

#### Flux Metrics Affected

The Flux Metrics analyze the three primary metrics that affect revenue (traffic, conversion rate, and average gift). This experiment produced the following results:

0% increase in traffic  
× 23.1% increase in conversion rate  
× 0% increase in average gift

#### Key Learnings

This test aimed to assess the impact of adding a visual monthly callout on the donation form. We hypothesized that this would create a stronger proposition for monthly giving. **Key Results:**

- +23% statistically significant **increase** (99%) in overall conversion rate.
- +56% statistically significant **increase** (100%) in overall RPV.
- +29% non-statistically significant **increase** (89%) in recurring conversion rate.
- +27% non-statistically significant **increase** (89%) in recurring RPV.
The variant showed a significant improvement in overall performance. Results show that the heart callout strengthened the monthly giving proposition while maintaining strong overall conversion and revenue outcomes. Directional lifts in recurring performance suggest increased engagement with the monthly option, without negatively impacting one-time giving.
